env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC access, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This generation eval builds and validates an SOP compliance-monitoring application as a delta off the `alerts` (2d_vlm) Foundation -- `alerts` is the only current developer profile that ships `vss-va-mcp` (the report layer mounts the get_sop_* patch onto it); it also carries ELK, Kafka, Redis, VIOS, and a VLM-perception slot. The get_sop_* patch is downloaded at build time from NVIDIA's public sop-monitoring-blueprints repo (pin 0dd472f) and staged BUILD-LOCAL under `_builds/sop-1/` -- nothing is vendored or written under `deploy/docker/`. It does NOT deploy: `ds-sop:1.0.0` is validated as an image reference (no image, models, or GPU required). Use `_builds/sop-1/` only as a filesystem label; existing files under `deploy/docker/` remain authoritative and unmodified.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build this deployment under `_builds/sop-1/`: "Compose an SOP compliance-monitoring application with SOP compliance reports." Select the closest current Foundation and the smallest delta; download and adapt the get_sop_* patch and stage it build-local, stage the SOP JSON Logstash pipeline as a build-local overlay, then run the Compose validation. Stop after validation; do NOT deploy.
checks: Selects the `alerts` (2d_vlm) Foundation and justifies it: `alerts` is the only current developer profile that ships `vss-va-mcp` (which the report layer needs), and it also owns Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, VIOS, and a VLM-perception slot -- so it is the smallest delta.

ADDS `ds-sop` (a new perception service needing `patches/ds-sop.yml`) and `sop-kibana-init`, and REMOVES `rtvi-vlm` (DS-SOP takes the perception slot) plus the unused `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `alert-bridge`, the alerts analytics/perception extras, and the LLM-NIM report key.
SOP compliance reports are skill-driven -- rendered by `vss-generate-video-report` (Mode C) from `get_sop_report` -- with no report service, VSS agent, web UI, or report LLM.

The get_sop_* patch is DOWNLOADED at build time from NVIDIA's public sop-monitoring-blueprints repo (pin 0dd472f), adapted, and staged BUILD-LOCAL under `_builds/sop-1/` (via `SOP_STAGE_DIR`) -- not vendored, not checked into the repo, and never written under `deploy/docker/`.

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/sop-1/override.env` exists with `FOUNDATION=alerts`, a full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and the DS-SOP + report knobs (`ENABLE_MESSAGING=1`, `DEFAULT_TOPIC=mdx-vlm-captions`, `SOP_MESSAGING_SCHEMA=JSON`, `ENABLE_RTSP_OUTPUT=true`, `RTSP_PORT=8554`, `SOP_STAGE_DIR`, `VSS_VA_MCP_CONFIG_FILE`, `VSS_AGENT_SITE_PACKAGES`).

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `ds-sop,sop-kibana-init,vss-va-mcp,nvstreamer-alerts,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,vss-haproxy-ingress,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms,phoenix`.
The exact set excludes `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `alert-bridge`, and every LLM-NIM profile key; `COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no `sop-1`, aggregate, or other invented profile key.

`_builds/sop-1/patches/` contains `ds-sop.yml` (the new perception service), `vss-va-mcp.yml` (the get_sop_* site-packages bind mounts, sourced from `${SOP_STAGE_DIR}`), and `logstash.yml` (repoints logstash's config + pipelines volume sources to the build-local overlay).

The adapted patch (`tools.py` = image tools.py + the four get_sop_* registrations; sibling `sop_tools.py`) is staged under `${SOP_STAGE_DIR}` = `_builds/sop-1/sop-report/video_analytics/` (build-local) -- the release tools.py is NOT mounted verbatim and no get_sop_* Python is checked into the repo.

The SOP JSON Logstash pipeline (`sop-vlm-captions-json-logstash.conf`) is registered as its OWN pipeline.id in a BUILD-LOCAL copy under `_builds/sop-1/patched/.../elk/logstash/`, NOT merged into the mdx-lvs protobuf pipeline.

`docker compose -f _builds/sop-1/resolved.yml config --quiet`, `--services`, and `--images` succeed; every selected profile key exists in the source graph, required peers (ELK, Kafka, VIOS) resolve, excluded services do not resolve, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, and no real `${...}` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains unresolved.
No file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified -- the get_sop_* patch, VA-MCP config, and SOP Logstash pipeline all live in the build-local `_builds/sop-1/` tree, not the tracked config.
